title: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Save the Koala) Bill 2021
short_title: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Save the Koala) Bill 2021

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would prevent federal environmental approval of actions involving koala habitat clearing and extend koala protections to forestry covered by Regional Forest Agreements.
It would apply a specific meaning of significant impact on koalas to existing approval and offence provisions, making actions with those impacts unlawful without approval.
The proposed restrictions would operate through amendments to the Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act and would commence on the day after Royal Assent.
changes: Regional Forest Agreement exemptions would cease where an action has, may have or is likely to have a significant impact on koalas.
New statutory definitions would identify koalas, koala habitat and koala habitat trees.
A new provision would connect the koala-specific impact test to the Act's existing approval prohibitions and associated offence.
summary.affected: The Environment Minister and people proposing or undertaking actions affecting koalas or their habitat are affected.
